subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Should production sweep continuation intentionally stop when action-ledger setup, finalization, or publication fails?
rationale: The implementation consistently enforces audit completeness, but code review cannot choose whether that guarantee should outweigh review/apply availability during ledger outages.

options.title: Fail closed on ledger health
options.body: Keep the current design so incomplete or ambiguous immutable receipts halt continuation pending operator reconciliation.

options.title: Decouple continuation
options.body: Surface ledger failures independently while allowing later sweep work to proceed after primary review or apply results are preserved.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Hold the feature until the repository defines a different policy for audit-ledger outages.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ledger health
recommendation.body: Keep the current design so incomplete or ambiguous immutable receipts halt continuation pending operator reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of production sweep continuation and availability behavior, while Vincent Koc owns the ledger implementation.
